import json
with open('DATA/products/PersonalizeForce.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Find ALL participants in competitor discussions and their first message
print('=== All participants in competitor discussions ===')
discussions = {}
for msg in data['slack']:
    text = msg['Message']['User'].get('text', '')
    if any(k in text.lower() for k in ['tailwind', 'tailorai', 'personaai', 'smartsuggest']):
        ts = msg['Message']['User'].get('timestamp', '')
        date = ts[:10]
        chan = msg['Channel'].get('name')
        user = msg['Message']['User']['userId']
        key = (date, chan)
        if key not in discussions:
            discussions[key] = []
        discussions[key].append((user, text[:300]))

for (date, chan), msgs in sorted(discussions.items()):
    print(f'\n=== {date} in {chan} ===')
    for user, text in msgs:
        print(f'  {user}: {text[:200]}')
EOF
